verdict.rationale: Hugging Face ships a first-party `hf` CLI Skill that lets coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor drive the hf CLI. That gives natural-language operation of the Hub (listing models, uploading, running jobs), but only through a third-party agent, not a native natural-language interface. The chat-completion API is model inference, not operating the product, and the openapi and docs-md probes are only building blocks, so none of them earn credit. Missing for 10: a native natural-language control surface in the product, documentation of the skill's scope and depth, and hands-on corroboration that agent-driven operation works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
